context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

content.text: {"head":"d2d502b5367e6074648ce92d4f462ec081f16173","verdict":"findings","coverage":["list/page.go"],"findings":[{"id":"ignored, computed by controller","priority":"P1","origin":"correctness","file":"list/page.go","start":19,"end":19,"explanation":"For any non-empty final page whose length is less than size, end exceeds len(items), so slicing items[start:end] panics instead of returning the remaining items as the comment promises.","action":"Clamp end to len(items) before slicing.","rule":"","head":"d2d502b5367e6074648ce92d4f462ec081f16173"},{"id":"ignored, computed by controller","priority":"P2","origin":"correctness","file":"list/page.go","start":14,"end":19,"explanation":"Negative page or size values can produce negative slice bounds and panic; size zero also yields behavior that is not defined by the function contract.","action":"Validate page and size before calculating slice bounds and return an appropriate empty result for invalid values.","rule":"","head":"d2d502b5367e6074648ce92d4f462ec081f16173"}]}
